title: keel lens verdict
description: A reviewer lens verdict (L10), captured at ingest from the child's final message, the MCP submit tool or the outbox and stored as VD-<sha12>.json. It binds the commit, the diff digest, the contract hash and the packet brief; a verdict bound to another contract hash is stale and ignored. The declared family of the lane is recorded by the Steward in the ledger, not by the seat.
$comment: Authored in the OpenAI strict subset (every property required, additionalProperties false, null unions instead of optional fields); scripts/validate.mjs lints it. Before passing it to a runtime flag the dispatcher bundles the $refs and strips $schema, $id, $comment, title and x-keel-* annotations.

brief_hash.description: BR echo of the review packet.

diff_digest.description: Digest of the reviewed diff, echoed from the packet.

contract_hash.description: Contract hash echoed from the packet.

readings.description: intent-alignment lens: the defensible readings of the frozen intent and whether the diff implements each; empty for other lenses.

declined.description: Items the lens declined to judge, with reasons.

specVerdict.description: Overall judgement against the lens question. intent_gap saves the patch and returns the proposal to framing; cannot_verify triggers a Steward re-run or an override.

finding.description: A finding. critical and important findings close only through a fix plus a scoped re-review by the same lane, or keel approve --rule dismiss.

id.description: Finding id, unique within the verdict, for example F1.

clause.description: Id of the clause the finding cites (ACC, R, INV or obligation), or null.
